_meta.note: Reference/master template file. Every key here must exist in hi/te/ta/kn/ml. Placeholders in {braces} must be kept exactly. Not served to users (the app ships five Indian languages).

labels.brand_tagline: Prashna - Vedic astrology in your language
labels.disclaimer: Astrology offers guidance, not certainty. Please use it alongside your own judgement and the advice of elders and professionals.

snapshot.intro: {name}, here is your first reading, drawn straight from your birth chart.
snapshot.moon_line: Your Moon is in {sign}, which is your rasi.
snapshot.nakshatra_line: You were born under {nakshatra} nakshatra, pada {pada}.
snapshot.dasha_line: You are now in {maha} mahadasha (until {maha_end}), and within it the {antar} antardasha (until {antar_end}).
snapshot.time_unknown: Your birth time is not known, so we used 12 noon. The lagna and anything that depends on it are approximate; the Moon sign and nakshatra are usually still reliable.
snapshot.moon_uncertain: The Moon changed sign on your birth day, so without an exact birth time your Moon sign is uncertain.
snapshot.nakshatra_uncertain: The Moon changed nakshatra on your birth day, so your birth star may be the neighbouring one.
snapshot.next_step: Ask a question in chat to go deeper into any of this for your own life.

lagna.Aries: You meet life head-on. You start things quickly, recover fast, and people notice your courage. Your lesson is patience with those who move slower than you.
lagna.Taurus: You are steady, loyal and sensory. You build slowly and keep what you build: home, savings, relationships. Once you decide, you rarely waver.
lagna.Gemini: You are curious and quick-witted. Conversation, learning and moving between many interests keep you alive. Choosing one path and finishing it is your quiet challenge.
lagna.Cancer: You lead with feeling and protect the people you love. Home and family are your anchor. Your moods run deep, so you need a safe place to recharge.
lagna.Leo: You carry natural dignity and warmth. People look to you to take charge, and you do it generously. You need respect, and you give it back in full.
lagna.Virgo: You notice what others miss. You like things done properly and quietly help everyone around you. Go easy on yourself; not everything needs fixing.
lagna.Libra: You seek balance and fairness, and you have a gift for bringing people together. Beauty and good manners matter to you. Decisions come slowly because you see every side.
lagna.Scorpio: You are intense, private and hard to fool. You feel deeply and remember everything. When you commit to a goal or a person, it is complete.
lagna.Sagittarius: You are open-hearted and guided by principles. Learning, teaching, travel and faith draw you. You speak honestly, sometimes more bluntly than you mean to.
lagna.Capricorn: You are practical and patient, and you climb steadily. Responsibility comes to you early. Your results grow with age, and so does your confidence.
lagna.Aquarius: You think independently and care about the wider good. Friends, groups and new ideas energise you. You can seem detached, but your loyalty runs deep.
lagna.Pisces: You are gentle, intuitive and generous. You sense what others feel before they say it. Faith, art or service give your life meaning; guard your energy from those who drain it.

moon_sign.Aries: Your mind is quick and decisive. You feel strongly and react fast, but you do not hold grudges for long.
moon_sign.Taurus: The Moon is exalted here: your mind is calm and steady. Comfort, good food and a stable home settle you.
moon_sign.Gemini: Your mind is restless and bright. Talking things through, reading and variety keep your spirits up.
moon_sign.Cancer: The Moon is at home here: you are caring, sensitive and deeply attached to family. Your intuition is strong.
moon_sign.Leo: Your heart is big and proud. You need appreciation, and you feel best when you can lead or create.
moon_sign.Virgo: Your mind analyses everything. You worry when things are untidy; order and useful work calm you.
moon_sign.Libra: You need harmony around you. Quarrels unsettle you, and a kind partner or friend restores your peace.
moon_sign.Scorpio: Your emotions run deep and private. You are fiercely loyal; trust, once broken, is hard for you to rebuild.
moon_sign.Sagittarius: Your mind is optimistic and seeks meaning. Freedom, faith and learning lift your mood.
moon_sign.Capricorn: You are emotionally reserved and dependable. You show love through duty and practical care.
moon_sign.Aquarius: You are thoughtful and a little detached. You process feelings through ideas and good friendships.
moon_sign.Pisces: Your heart is soft and imaginative. Prayer, music or quiet time near water restores you.

nakshatra.Ashwini: Ruled by Ketu and blessed by the Ashwini Kumaras, the divine healers: you are quick to act, quick to help, and have a natural healing touch.
nakshatra.Bharani: Ruled by Venus under Yama: you carry great endurance and a strong sense of right and wrong. You can bear burdens others cannot.
nakshatra.Krittika: Ruled by the Sun under Agni: sharp, honest and purifying. You cut through confusion, and your words can both protect and sting.
nakshatra.Rohini: Ruled by the Moon, Lord Krishna's own star: charming, creative and fond of beauty. People are drawn to you easily.
nakshatra.Mrigashira: Ruled by Mars under Soma: a seeker's star. You are gentle and curious, always looking for the next thing to learn or explore.
nakshatra.Ardra: Ruled by Rahu under Rudra: you grow through storms. Your mind is sharp and searching, and you are at your best after difficulty.
nakshatra.Punarvasu: Ruled by Jupiter under Aditi: the star of return and renewal. However often life scatters things, you rebuild with kindness and hope.
nakshatra.Pushya: Ruled by Saturn under Brihaspati, the most auspicious of stars: nourishing, dutiful and protective. People feel safe with you.
nakshatra.Ashlesha: Ruled by Mercury under the Nagas: perceptive and strategic. You read people deeply; use that insight to heal rather than to guard.
nakshatra.Magha: Ruled by Ketu under the Pitris: you carry the dignity of your lineage. Respect for elders and tradition brings you blessings.
nakshatra.Purva Phalguni: Ruled by Venus under Bhaga: warm, artistic and pleasure-loving. You bring joy and ease into the lives around you.
nakshatra.Uttara Phalguni: Ruled by the Sun under Aryaman: generous and dependable. You keep your promises, and friendships with you last a lifetime.
nakshatra.Hasta: Ruled by the Moon under Savitr: skilled hands and a clever mind. You can make, mend and manage almost anything.
nakshatra.Chitra: Ruled by Mars under Vishwakarma, the divine architect: you have an eye for design and love to create something beautiful and lasting.
nakshatra.Swati: Ruled by Rahu under Vayu: independent and adaptable like the wind. You thrive when you have room to move and trade ideas.
nakshatra.Vishakha: Ruled by Jupiter under Indra and Agni: goal-driven and determined. Once you fix a target, you pursue it until it is won.
nakshatra.Anuradha: Ruled by Saturn under Mitra: the star of friendship and devotion. You succeed through cooperation and stay loyal far from home.
nakshatra.Jyeshtha: Ruled by Mercury under Indra: the elder's star. You take responsibility, protect others and carry quiet authority.
nakshatra.Mula: Ruled by Ketu under Nirriti: you go to the root of things. Old structures fall away so that something truer can grow in your life.
nakshatra.Purva Ashadha: Ruled by Venus under Apas, the waters: the invincible star. Your conviction is strong and you rarely give up.
nakshatra.Uttara Ashadha: Ruled by the Sun under the Vishvedevas: righteous and steady. Your victories come late but they are lasting.
nakshatra.Shravana: Ruled by the Moon under Vishnu: the listener's star. You learn by listening, and your wisdom grows through teachers and scripture.
nakshatra.Dhanishta: Ruled by Mars under the Vasus: rhythmic, prosperous and generous. Music, teamwork and giving bring you abundance.
nakshatra.Shatabhisha: Ruled by Rahu under Varuna: the star of a hundred healers. You are private, thoughtful and drawn to remedies and hidden truths.
nakshatra.Purva Bhadrapada: Ruled by Jupiter under Aja Ekapada: intense and idealistic. You can transform yourself completely for a cause you believe in.
nakshatra.Uttara Bhadrapada: Ruled by Saturn under Ahirbudhnya: deep, calm and wise. You stay steady in a crisis and others lean on your patience.
nakshatra.Revati: Ruled by Mercury under Pushan, the guardian of travellers: gentle, protective and kind to all. You guide others safely home.

maha.Sun: Sun mahadasha (6 years) brings you forward: authority, recognition, dealings with government and father come into focus. Your health and self-respect need care.
maha.Moon: Moon mahadasha (10 years) centres on the heart: mother, home, emotional life and public dealings. Your peace of mind shapes your results.
maha.Mars: Mars mahadasha (7 years) brings energy and action: property, land, siblings, competition and courage. Channel the fire; avoid haste and quarrels.
maha.Rahu: Rahu mahadasha (18 years) brings ambition and unusual turns: foreign links, technology, sudden rises and restlessness. Stay grounded and honest.
maha.Jupiter: Jupiter mahadasha (16 years) brings growth and grace: learning, children, teachers, faith and wealth expand. Good counsel finds you.
maha.Saturn: Saturn mahadasha (19 years) rewards patience and hard work: career responsibility, discipline and slow but lasting results. Shortcuts do not pay now.
maha.Mercury: Mercury mahadasha (17 years) sharpens the mind: education, business, writing, communication and trade flourish with clever effort.
maha.Ketu: Ketu mahadasha (7 years) turns you inward: detachment, spirituality, sudden endings and intuition. Let go of what no longer serves you.
maha.Venus: Venus mahadasha (20 years) brings comfort and relationships: marriage, arts, vehicles, beauty and enjoyment of life's pleasures.

antar.Sun: The Sun antardasha adds recognition and a need to step up, with some pressure on ego and health.
antar.Moon: The Moon antardasha adds emotion, family matters and travel; keep your mind calm.
antar.Mars: The Mars antardasha adds drive and urgency; good for bold effort, bad for quick temper.
antar.Rahu: The Rahu antardasha adds sudden opportunities and confusion alike; verify before you trust.
antar.Jupiter: The Jupiter antardasha adds wisdom, support and good news around family and learning.
antar.Saturn: The Saturn antardasha adds responsibility and delay; steady work now builds lasting results.
antar.Mercury: The Mercury antardasha adds activity in study, trade and communication.
antar.Ketu: The Ketu antardasha adds detachment and introspection; spiritual practice helps.
antar.Venus: The Venus antardasha adds harmony, comforts and relationship matters.

tara.1: Today's Moon returns to your own birth star. Feelings run strong; keep the day simple and look after your health.
tara.2: Today's Moon falls in your Sampat tara, a star of gain. A good day for money matters, purchases and asking for what you need.
tara.3: Today's Moon falls in your Vipat tara. Small obstacles are likely; double-check plans and avoid risky decisions.
tara.4: Today's Moon falls in your Kshema tara, the star of well-being. Things move smoothly, and it is a good day to care for home and health.
tara.5: Today's Moon falls in your Pratyak tara. You may meet resistance; stay patient, avoid arguments and do not force outcomes.
tara.6: Today's Moon falls in your Sadhana tara, the star of accomplishment. Efforts made today bear fruit; push forward on important work.
tara.7: Today's Moon falls in your Naidhana tara, the most delicate of the nine. Postpone major starts, drive carefully and keep a quiet mind.
tara.8: Today's Moon falls in your Mitra tara. Friends and colleagues are helpful; a good day to meet people and collaborate.
tara.9: Today's Moon falls in your Parama mitra tara, a very friendly star. Support comes easily; begin something you care about.

chandra.1: The Moon passes over your own rasi: you feel things strongly today. Rest and good company help.
chandra.2: The Moon is in the 2nd from your rasi: watch your words and spending, and enjoy family meals.
chandra.3: The Moon is in the 3rd from your rasi: courage and energy are high. Good for short trips and initiatives.
chandra.4: The Moon is in the 4th from your rasi: you may feel unsettled. Spend time at home and with your mother.
chandra.5: The Moon is in the 5th from your rasi: creative and romantic, but avoid speculation.
chandra.6: The Moon is in the 6th from your rasi: you can beat problems and competitors today. Clear pending work.
chandra.7: The Moon is in the 7th from your rasi: partnerships and meetings go well. A good day for your spouse and for deals.
chandra.8: The Moon is in the 8th from your rasi (Chandrashtama): keep a low profile, avoid new ventures and look after your health.
chandra.9: The Moon is in the 9th from your rasi: a good day for prayer, elders and teachers.
chandra.10: The Moon is in the 10th from your rasi: work gets noticed. Take the lead on something important.
chandra.11: The Moon is in the 11th from your rasi: gains and good news. Friends help you reach your goals.
chandra.12: The Moon is in the 12th from your rasi: expenses and tiredness are possible. Rest well and give in charity.

daily.title: {name}'s day, {date}
daily.rahu_tip: Avoid starting anything new during Rahu kalam ({start} - {end}).
daily.no_profile: Add your birth details to get your personal day forecast.

alerts.sade_sati_start: Sade Sati begins on {date}: Saturn enters {sign}, the 12th from your Moon. A 7.5-year period of maturity and hard-won results starts; plan carefully and stay patient.
alerts.sade_sati_peak: The peak phase of Sade Sati starts on {date}: Saturn moves over your Moon sign {sign}. Take care of health and relationships; keep up steady effort.
alerts.sade_sati_final: The final phase of Sade Sati starts on {date}: Saturn enters {sign}, the 2nd from your Moon. Pressure starts to ease; manage finances and family carefully.
alerts.sade_sati_end: Sade Sati ends on {date} as Saturn moves into {sign}. Lessons of the past years begin to turn into results.
alerts.dhaiya_4: Ardhashtama Shani begins on {date}: Saturn enters {sign}, the 4th from your Moon. Take care of home, property matters and peace of mind.
alerts.dhaiya_8: Ashtama Shani begins on {date}: Saturn enters {sign}, the 8th from your Moon. Avoid risks, look after health and be patient with delays.
alerts.maha_change: Your {lord} mahadasha begins on {date}, after the {prev} mahadasha. A new chapter of life starts.
alerts.antar_change: Your {lord} antardasha begins on {date} within the {maha} mahadasha.
alerts.eclipse_touch_moon: , your Moon sign: rest, pray and avoid major decisions around that day
alerts.eclipse_touch_lagna: , your lagna: look after health and avoid major decisions around that day
alerts.jupiter_good: Jupiter enters {sign} on {date}, the {ord} from your Moon: a supportive transit for growth, family and good fortune.
alerts.jupiter_hard: Jupiter enters {sign} on {date}, the {ord} from your Moon: a quieter transit; rely on effort and good counsel.
alerts.saturn_good: Saturn enters {sign} on {date}, the {ord} from your Moon: a favourable transit that rewards steady work.
alerts.saturn_hard: Saturn enters {sign} on {date}, the {ord} from your Moon: a testing transit that asks for patience.

matching.excellent: An excellent match. The stars support a harmonious, prosperous married life.
matching.very_good: A very good match. Minds and temperaments sit well together; small differences are easily managed.
matching.acceptable: An acceptable match. The union can work well with understanding; review the points of caution below with your family astrologer.
matching.not_recommended: A weak match on guna milan. Traditionally this needs careful review and remedies before going ahead.
matching.nadi_dosha: Nadi dosha: both share the same nadi, traditionally a concern for health and progeny. Check for cancellations and remedies.
matching.bhakoot_dosha: Bhakoot dosha: the Moon signs are in a difficult relationship ({d1}/{d2}), which can strain finances or harmony.
matching.gana_mismatch: Gana mismatch: temperaments differ; patience and respect will matter.
matching.manglik_both: Both are Manglik, so the dosha is traditionally considered cancelled.
matching.manglik_one: One partner is Manglik and the other is not; traditionally this needs remedies or further review.
matching.rajju_dosha: Rajju dosha is present in the South Indian porutham system, which is traditionally treated as a strong objection.
matching.time_unknown: One birth time is unknown, so the Manglik check (which depends on lagna) is approximate.

muhurta.tithi_rikta: {tithi} is a Rikta tithi; avoid new beginnings.
muhurta.tara_good: The day's star is favourable for {name} (tarabala).
muhurta.tara_bad: The day's star is unfavourable for {name} (tarabala).
muhurta.chandra_good: The Moon is well placed from {name}'s rasi (chandrabala).
muhurta.chandra_bad: The Moon is poorly placed from {name}'s rasi (chandrabala).
muhurta.best_time: Best time: {start} - {end}, avoiding Rahu kalam, Yamagandam and Gulika.
muhurta.note: This list uses classical panchanga rules (tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga, karana) and personal tarabala/chandrabala. For marriage, confirm the final lagna muhurta with your family priest or astrologer.

rectify.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a certainty. It scores candidate birth times by how well the dasha periods and planetary transits fit the life events you gave. More events with exact dates give better results. Treat the top candidates as a starting point for an astrologer to confirm.
rectify.reason_dasha: {event} on {date} falls in {maha}/{antar}/{pratyantar} dasha, which connects to this area of life.
rectify.reason_transit: Jupiter or Saturn activated the relevant house around {event} ({date}).
rectify.reason_lagna: With this time the lagna is {sign}.
